about_the_game:
In the demo, only one weapon, one product item, and a single enemy attack are available for testing.

Weird Mart is a fun FPV (First Person) store management shooter. Organize your shelves, restock products, and keep your customers happy. But stay alert — zombies, thieves, and aliens can attack your store anytime. Survive and grow your business!

content_descriptors.notes: This game does not contain graphic violence, sexual content, or drug/alcohol use. Players will experience a low-poly survival game focused on store management and defending against waves of monsters.
